react_result.final_narrative_text: The differential metabolome is dominated by arachidonic acid derivatives, providing cross-paradigm evidence of pathway-level perturbation. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis identified 'Arachidonic acid metabolism' (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) as the top hit (rank 1, p=4.2×10⁻⁴) with a striking 100% overlap: all six input HETEs and HPETEs (8(S)-HPETE KEGG:C14823, 16(R)-HETE KEGG:C14778, 19(S)-HETE KEGG:C14749, 11,12,15-THETA KEGG:C14782, plus thromboxane KEGG:C02198) were mapped to this network module. MetaboAnalystR PSEA independently ranked KEGG:hsa00590 (Arachidonic acid metabolism) at rank 4 (p=0.0807), corroborating the same metabolic axis. The second mummichog hit, 'Prostaglandin formation from arachidonate' (p=9.8×10⁻³), further anchors the COX/LOX branch of this pathway as the affected sub-module. RaMP multi-DB ORA independently flagged 'Signaling by Nuclear Receptors' (REACT:R-HSA-9006931, FDR=0.00145) via 4-hydroxyretinoic acid and S-adenosylmethionine, indicating concurrent retinoid nuclear-receptor signaling and methyltransferase-dependent epigenetic regulation. The purine antagonist theophylline and the cofactor SAM independently point toward adenosine signaling and methylation biology. The primary driver cluster — six arachidonic acid oxygenated metabolites — constitutes the clear winner across paradigms, with the prostaglandin/thromboxane branch as the most mechanistically interpretable effector arm.

react_result.final_narrative_text: The differential metabolome was interrogated across three complementary analytical paradigms: mummichog m/z‑direct pathway activity, RaMP multi‑DB ORA, and MetaboAnalystR PSEA. Mummichog identified Arachidonic acid metabolism (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) as the top hit with p=9.24×10⁻⁴ and 9 input compounds in the arachidonic acid metabolite subnetwork. Prostaglandin formation from arachidonate (MUMM:prostaglandin_formation_from_arachidonate) ranked second with p=9.58×10⁻³. RaMP ORA independently flagged Signaling by Nuclear Receptors (REACT:R-HSA-9006931) as the top result (FDR=0.00145, fold enrichment 435.8) with 4-hydroxyretinoic acid as the sole contributing compound, and Biological oxidations (REACT:R-HSA-211859) with 4-hydroxyretinoic acid and S-adenosylmethionine as hits. MetaboAnalystR PSEA ranked Retinol metabolism (KEGG:hsa00830) at p=0.0421 with 4-hydroxyretinoic acid as the sole hit. The three driver metabolites anchoring the arachidonic acid subnetwork are 19(S)-HETE, 16(R)-HETE, and 11,12,15-THETA. Thromboxane (as thromboxane A2) and 11,12,15-THETA are shared members of both the broad arachidonic acid network and the prostaglandin formation module, indicating that the prostaglandin/thromboxane branch is a mechanistically supported effector arm of the lipid signal disruption.
